description: Remaining 9 routing cases for using-cloudbox-skills (USE-01 already executed separately, per execution-ledger.json), converted from evals/skill-routing-cases.csv for real execution against cloudbox-skills task #7 (statistical-rigor gap). CORRECTED 2026-08-28: USE-02/03/04's expected.primary_skill was originally set to 'using-cloudbox-skills' by mistranslating the CSV's 3rd column (the skill UNDER TEST for this row, not the expected answer -- every USE-* row reads 'using-cloudbox-skills' there, including USE-06/07 which were converted correctly). The router is never a valid primary_skill or supporting_skill per runtime_eval_common.py's strict 'router_not_downstream' check and this skill's own SKILL.md/references/conversation-routing-map.md -- 'which skills, what order' questions are answered BY the router THROUGH supporting_skills/execution_order, not by naming itself primary_skill. USE-02/03/04's expected.primary_skill is now the real downstream deliverable owner, matching the model's own actual (pre-mistake) reasoning captured in evals/runtime/results/use-0{2,3,4}-20260825T*.jsonl. See .agents/skills/using-cloudbox-skills/lifecycle.json's 2026-08-28 note for the full incident writeup.
